articles.title: Hut 8's Texas power site sits inside Anthropic’s $35 billion AI deal
articles.snippet: The company's Texas campus has two long-term leases worth $19.6 billion, more than 260 times its latest quarterly revenue, as AI companies race to secure power and data-center capacity.

articles.title: Ireland bars crypto from new tax-advantaged investment accounts
articles.snippet: Eligible assets for the new accounts include listed stocks, bonds, and ETFs, with providers handling tax reporting to simplify investor compliance.

articles.title: Bitmine makes largest ether purchase since June as Tom Lee points to crypto's strong Q3
articles.snippet: Company Chairman Lee said crypto’s recent outperformance could draw more institutional investors.

articles.title: Strategy returns to bitcoin buys, adding $370 million of BTC last week
articles.snippet: It's the first week of bitcoin purchases for the Michael Saylor-led company in about two months.

articles.title: Asia sees digital asset custody infrastructure deals from Ripple, Coincheck
articles.snippet: Ripple was among the latest blockchain companies to sign a strategic partnership to build more custody and tokenized asset management solutions for Asian institutional participants.
